base_policy: released non-Stealing Hard v1.2.0; unchanged coefficients and base banking cutoffs
selection_basis: Highest match-point rate in the predeclared chain-scoped grid, with positive direct comparisons against greedy blend 0.5, 0.75, 1, the safe-finish-only control, and chain-scoped blend 1.25. All are tuning, not holdout evidence. No further coefficient tuning after this freeze.
decision: For multiple-bearing rolls only, search legal scoring paths and Bank/Roll actions with existing opening and score-position/endgame constraints. Prioritize an available outright win. Value a roll as P + pBust * (adjustedThreshold - P); a saved chain uses exact one-roll expected new score divided by bust probability, before existing score-position adjustments. Hot dice clear the chain and use the existing six-dice calibration. Elsewhere use the released greedy selection and independently protect an available outright win. Stealing, Easy, and Medium retain their separate policies.
promotion_requirements: The primary holdout must favor the candidate over released Hard with a paired 95% interval above 50%. Compare with greedy and safe-finish alternatives, Medium, and relevant rules/targets. Preserve losing or inconclusive results and do not relabel a tuned-on holdout. Integration additionally requires deterministic real-scorer, three-axis, parity, persistence, performance, build and release validation.
